title: [v2.8.2.1-dev-d] Overview and Treatment tab not updated with TBR
symptom: Overview and Treatment tab not updated with TBR. Basal shown on overview stopped updating, no TBR records visible in Treatment tab, manual TBR not visible, restarting AAPS or phone did not help. Downgrading to previous version restored updates.
cause: Regression appeared between dev-c (March 01) and dev-d (March 17). Fixed by Insight driver and database.
fix: Downgrade to previous version (2.8.2.1-dev) to recover data, then update again to dev-d. The issue was fixed by Insight driver and database update.
evidence_quote: this regression appeared between the dev-c (OK) of March 01 and the dev-d (KO) of March 17... (I hope that update of Insight Driver with room will solve if...) Fixed by Insight driver and database
